def rational_reduce(numerator, denominator):
    if denominator == 0:
        raise ValueError("Denominator cannot be zero")
    import math
    g = math.gcd(numerator, denominator)
    numerator //= g
    denominator //= g
    if denominator < 0:
        numerator = -numerator
        denominator = -denominator
    return numerator, denominator
